title: DorokeiGame
description: DorokeiGame v3.0 - Lobby System & Enhanced Effects
body:
# 🚔 DorokeiGame - ドロケイゲーム

A thrilling Japanese "Cops and Robbers" (Dorokei/Keido) minigame plugin.

## 🆕 v3.0 New Features

### Lobby System
- **Multiple Lobbies** - Create multiple lobby areas
- **Max 20 Players** - Each lobby supports up to 20 players
- **Sign Join** - Click signs to join lobbies
- **Command Join** - `/dorokei join <ID>`

### Game Area Management
- **Area Definition** - Define rectangular areas with pos1/pos2
- **Escape Prevention** - Players cannot leave the game area
- **Multiple Areas** - Create multiple game areas
- **Lobby Linking** - Link lobbies to specific areas

### Multi-Instance Support
- **Simultaneous Games** - Run multiple games at once
- **Independent Management** - Each game runs independently
- **Persistent Config** - Settings saved to config.yml

### Auto Cop Allocation
- **Player-Based** - Cop count auto-determined by player count
- **Balanced** - Optimized for 2-20 players
- **Preparation Time** - 30 second escape preparation time

## ✨ Core Features

### Rich UI
- **Scoreboard** - Time, escaped/captured count, role
- **Boss Bar** - Time visualization (green → yellow → red)
- **Countdown** - 3-second countdown animation

### Spectacular Effects
- **Capture** - Screen flash, thunder, particles
- **Prison** - Slowness, beacon display, floor particles
- **Rescue** - Explosion effects, speed boost

### Tracking System (Always Active)
- **Particle Tracking** - Particles above civilians (cops only)
- **Distance Colors** - Red (close) → Yellow → Blue (far)
- **Direction Display** - 8 directions + Y-coordinate
- **3D Sound** - Heartbeat sound for direction
- **Compass** - Points to nearest player

## Commands

### Setup Commands (Admin)
```
/dorokei setup spawn - Set spawn point
/dorokei setup lobby <ID> [name] - Set lobby
/dorokei setup area <ID> pos1 [name] - Area start
/dorokei setup area <ID> pos2 - Area end
/dorokei setup area <ID> jail - Set jail
/dorokei setup link <lobbyID> <areaID> - Link
```

### Player Commands
```
/dorokei join <lobbyID> - Join lobby
/dorokei leave - Leave lobby
```

### Management Commands
```
/dorokei list - Show all lobbies/areas
/dorokei gamestart <lobbyID> - Start game
```

**Alias:** /dk

## Auto Cop Allocation

| Players | Cops |
|---------|------|
| 2-4 | 1 |
| 5-6 | 2 |
| 7-8 | 3 |
| 9-11 | 4 |
| 12-14 | 5 |
| 15-17 | 6 |
| 18-20 | 7 |

## Requirements
- Spigot/Paper 1.21.x
- Java 22+
- No dependencies

---

## 日本語 (Japanese)

警官と市民に分かれて遊ぶドロケイ（警ドロ）ミニゲームプラグインです。

**v3.0新機能:**
- ロビーシステム（複数ロビー、最大20人）
- ゲームエリア管理（範囲設定、脱出防止）
- 複数ゲーム同時実行
- config.yml永続化
- 警官自動割り振り（2-20人対応）

**基本ルール:** 警官が市民を捕まえる鬼ごっこ。捕まった市民は牢獄に送られ、仲間が救出可能。制限時間まで逃げ切れば市民の勝利。
